data_fields.name: map_max_depth
data_fields.donor_constant: 10 when unset (defect in the setting read)

best_idea: Draw a local map of zones around the player by a depth-limited walk over the zone graph, placing each zone one fixed step from the zone it was reached from, and draw connectors only for exits the player can take.
decision_why: A depth-limited, placed-once walk gives a zone minimap for the client HUD (row 14) with zones as data. Adapt it: draw stubs only for traversable exits (the donor leaks locked ones at line 198), and take the traversable set from server-owned zone data.
acceptance: On a 375-px-wide screen the zone map shows the current zone and each zone within the set depth that the player can reach; a locked exit draws no connector; a zone already placed is not drawn twice.
